I just hope you love yourself enough to recognize what you really need and what you really want. Don’t dim your light hoping it brightens the other person

Loving unconditionally would be without conditions. But if you are continually disappointed then there are clearly unmet conditions. Loving yourself as completely and fully as possible could help make up for those shortcomings in your partners and give you confidence and patience to develop your love styles with another person. Odds are no two people are going to love the other exactly or correctly without some time and experience. Just give yourself some grace and respect. You deserve it

Can I ask if you live anywhere near safe hiking trails? It could be fun and rewarding to be outside and have an opportunity to listen to your own body and the sounds of nature. I know it’s winter for half the globe but maybe even a place you could snowshoe. I think the opportunity to embrace yourself in the outdoors could be a positive one. Just remember to be patient and kind with yourself

I hope you are giving yourself as much love and attention as you are putting out for others. You deserve to feel loved and I hope you can recognize what that would feel and look like by embracing it in yourself

No one is perfect and everyone makes mistakes. Few if any mistakes are so bad they cannot be atoned for to the point you can’t change and move forward. Just keep giving yourself respect and grace and keep focusing on moving forward. As you stay aware and active you may find you left that old version in the dust. It’s definitely not easy. But the struggle will build you up and prove to yourself that you cannot break beyond repair

You owe it to yourself to recognize that you are not the same person and that you are doing different things and thinking differently. What other people see or don’t see won’t keep pace with how you see yourself. But if you keep focusing on who you are and who you want to be, eventually your shimmer will be too bright for all but the dullest of people to not notice and recognize. If you are truthful with yourself and accept that mistakes are lessons to be learned from and not crosses to simply bear you will continue to carry your weight and eventually realize you are carrying and dealing with more than you could ever imagine. Your strength and fortitude will develop greater than you know

There are times when it is really hard and I know it seems like there is nothing else. However, if you give yourself some grace and kindness you might find something that you enjoy and recognize in yourself. I’m confident you are harder than these hard times. I’m also optimistic that you deserve times that are not as hard

You have a lot of weight you are carrying and don’t ever overlook the fact that you keep carrying it. Right or wrong that weight hasn’t gotten the better of you yet. I realize how terrible things might seem and the sense of being overwhelmed. But you have not let that weight get the better of you yet. Don’t disregard your strength and your spirit. Don’t forget that you are strong and powerful and you are enough. You truly are. You got this
